acceptance: Coordinate sequential launcher and evidence-validator child tasks to add a bounded parameterless focused_check capability with a code-owned fixed deterministic suite and fail-closed bounded evidence.

Preserve same-worktree read-only evidence-validator operation, fixed git_inspect, no session, approval, skills, web, shell, mutation, delegation, provider, task, commit, integration, or completion authority, and caller metadata as diagnostic only.

Require the fixed suite identifier, literal argv/file set, timeout/output caps, unavailable/nonzero/timeout/truncation failure handling, and no caller-controlled command/path/argument/environment/cwd surface.

Validate child closure and integration, launcher/profile/extension behavior, role contract and focused checks, task-record/content/backlog/JSON/whitespace checks, and fresh read-only final expert review before root completion.
Preserve and account for the cancelled documentation-only skills/spawning-pi-subagents task; remove the exact root backlog identity only in the final completion handoff.
